title: Remote Payment Operations Chat Support – Floating Shift (30 Hours/Week)
description:
PAYJN is a global payment service provider seeking a disciplined and detail-oriented Payment Operations Chat Support Specialist based in the Philippines.



This is a fully remote, non-voice position. The work is primarily conducted through written chat and involves checking transaction information, following operational procedures, and assisting merchants professionally and accurately.



This is a long-term floating-shift position, not a short-term freelance project. It is suitable for someone who can work independently, remain attentive during quiet periods, and reliably cover different operating shifts.



GUARANTEED WEEKLY SCHEDULE



You will normally receive three 10-hour shifts per week, equivalent to 30 guaranteed hours.



Regular floating coverage in Manila Time (GMT+8):



• Wednesday: 15:00–01:00

• Friday: 05:00–15:00

• Saturday: 19:00–05:00



Additional shifts may become available when regular employees are absent, on leave, or when emergency coverage is required. Emergency coverage is normally communicated at least three hours in advance. Additional approved shifts are paid based on actual tracked time.



SCHEDULE EXPECTATIONS



• You must be able to work all three regular floating shifts.

• You must be comfortable working morning, afternoon, and overnight schedules.

• You may be asked to temporarily cover a fixed shift when another employee is on leave.

• Outside work is permitted only if it never conflicts with PAYJN schedules or confirmed coverage duties.

• Once you accept an additional shift, you are expected to report on time and complete it fully.



COMPENSATION



Floating-shift compensation is calculated from a USD 400 monthly full-time base:



USD 400 ÷ 26 working days ÷ 10 hours

= approximately USD 1.5385 per approved hour.



At 30 hours per week, expected monthly earnings are normally around USD 185–200, depending on the calendar and approved hours worked. Additional approved shifts increase your earnings.



Payroll is processed twice monthly, normally between the 1st–3rd and the 16th–18th. Payment is made in USDT through the TRC20 network.



PAID TRAINING



Selected candidates receive three days of paid training, 10 hours per day.



• Days 1–2: Guided training with an experienced tea
mber

• Day 3: Practical assessment

• Training is paid at the same approved hourly rate.

• Three fully completed training days equal approximately USD 46.15.

• Completed and verified training time is paid even if the candidate does not pass.

• Completing training does not guarantee continued employment.



CAREER PATH



Strong floating-shift employees may apply for a fixed full-time position when staffing needs allow.



Potential full-time compensation:

• Probationary full-time role: USD 400/month

• Regular full-time role: USD 450/month

• Shift leader role: Up to USD 500/month

• Eligible full-time employees may receive a USD 35 full-attendance bonus.



Promotion depends on accuracy, reliability, learning performance, and company requirements. It is not guaranteed based only on length of service.



MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS



• At least two years of relevant work experience

• College-level education or higher preferred

• Strong BPO, banking, fintech, payment, e-commerce, crypto, or transactional support experience is preferred

• Strong written English and fast, accurate typing

• Comfortable working with numbers, transaction references, screenshots, and system records

• Able to learn and retain structured procedures

• Able to recognize unusual cases and escalate instead of guessing

• Professional and emotionally stable under pressure



THIS ROLE IS NOT SUITABLE FOR SOMEONE WHO:



• Relies only on copy-and-paste answers

• Frequently needs the same procedure explained repeatedly

• Guesses when transaction information is unclear

• Disappears during assigned working hours

• Cannot maintain focus while working remotely

• Has commitments that conflict with assigned shifts

• Is unable to work the three listed schedules



ATTENDANCE AND PERFORMANCE



• Be fully ready before the scheduled shift begins.

• Remain online and responsive throughout the assigned shift.

• Customer messages should normally be acknowledged within 1–3 minutes.

• Reasonable short personal breaks may be self-managed, provided coverage and response times are not affected.

• Group attendance records and automated online-status checks verify availability.

• Late arrival and early departure are deducted based on actual approved minutes.

• Unreported absence, falsified attendance, or repeated disappearance may result in removal from the roster or termination.



TIME TRACKING AND TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS



TimeProof must remain active throughout every assigned shift. Approved TimeProof records are the primary basis for payroll. Technical problems must be reported in the work group during the same shift.



You must have:

• A reliable PC or laptop; mobile-only work is not accepted

• Stable primary internet and a backup connection

• Reliable electricity or a practical power-outage backup plan

• A quiet workspace suitable for focused, confidential work

• The ability to restrict personal phone use and unrelated activities during shifts



HOW TO APPLY



Send everything below in ONE complete message. Multiple incomplete messages may be treated as failure to follow instructions.



Start the first line with the exact word:



PAYJN



Then include:



1. A brief professional introduction

2. Your latest resume

3. Your highest educational qualification

4. Exact dates and duties for your relevant work experience

5. Confirmation that you can regularly work all three listed shifts

6. Confirmation that you can accept emergency coverage with approximately three hours’ notice when available

7. Details of any current work or commitments that could affect scheduling

8. A screenshot of your current internet speed test

9. Your computer specifications, including processor, RAM, and storage

10. Your backup plan for internet and power interruptions



Qualified applicants receive a short assessment covering written English, transaction and numerical checking, following a simulated procedure, abnormal-case escalation, and typing accuracy.



Applicants who pass may be invited to
 for further discussion. Only selected candidates receive an offer for the three-day paid training period.

title: Overnight CCTV Camera Operator — WFH, Full Benefits
description:
About us



We're an Australian site-monitoring and surveillance company. We run CCTV camera systems across construction and infrastructure sites, and we monitor them through our own software platform. We're building a small overnight team to watch live camera feeds, spot when something isn't right, and make a quick phone call to the right person while our Australian sites are unattended.



You don't need security or CCTV experience. We'll train you on everything. What we need is a sharp, tech-savvy person with excellent English who can stay alert, make a sensible judgement call, and pick up the phone with confidence.  Also, the ability to confidently organise Teams/video conferencing meetings as required.



You'll be employed compliantly through an Employer of Record (Native Teams), with full statutory benefits — SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, 13th-month pay, and night differential. This is a real long-term role with a growing company, not a short gig.



What you'll do



Watch multiple live camera feeds inside our software during overnight shifts

Notice when something looks wrong and d
 whether it's a real issue or a false alarm

When it's real, make the phone call — calmly and clearly notify the right person and follow a simple escalation chain

Write short, clear, time-stamped notes on what happened

Flag any cameras that go offline or look faulty

Work as part of a small overnight team





What we're looking for



Excellent spoken and written English — you'll be making phone calls and writing clear notes, so confident, professional communication is essential

Tech-savvy and quick to learn — comfortable picking up new software fast and working across multiple screens and feeds (this matters far more than any specific prior tool)

Good judgement under quiet conditions — able to stay alert through a calm night shift and tell the difference between a real event and a false one

Confident on the phone/video conferencing — you won't hesitate to call someone, even at 3am, when the situation calls for it

Reliable fibre internet PLUS a backup connection (mobile data or a second line)

Power backup — UPS or generator — so an outage doesn't take you offline mid-shift

A quiet, dedicated work-from-home space





No CCTV, security, or monitoring background required — if you're sharp, reliable, communicate well, and can stay focused overnight, we'll teach you the rest.



Shift & pay





Night shift aligned to Australian overnight hours (Philippine time is only ~2–3 hours behind, so this is a much gentler night shift than US or UK monitoring work)

Generous salary

Long-term, stable, full-time — we're building a team and want people who'll grow with us





How to apply



Reply with these three things. Applications missing any of them won't be reviewed — attention to detail is the first thing this job tests:





A short paragraph about a time you had to stay focused, think clearly under pressure, or make a quick judgement call — in any job or situation, not just security

Your internet setup — provider, speed, and what backup connection you have

A few sentences on why you'd be good at staying sharp overnight and confident making phone calls/video calls — tell us about your English, any phone/customer-facing experience, and how comfortable you are learning new software





We read every application that includes all three.

title: Executive Assistant to CEO
description:
Position Overview:



As the Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth and efficient functioning of the executive office. Your primary responsibility will be to provide comprehensive administrative support to the CEO, managing their schedule, and coordinating various tasks to enhance productivity. Your ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, and proactively handle administrative duties will contribute to the overall effectiveness of the CEO's office.





Pay Range: $8 per hour with a performance review scheduled after 90 days of employment. We believe in rewarding exceptional talents.





About Power Plus Systems:



Power Plus Systems LLC has been a dominant force in the residential electrical contracting industry for two decades, and we continue to lead the way. Our vision is to successfully wire 28,000 homes to completion by the year 2029, ensuring safe and efficient electrical solutions, thereby making a positive impact on the lives of our customers and communities. At Power Plus Systems, LLC, a position with us isn't just a job; it's an opportunity to grow and develop within a company that genuinely appreciates your contributions and dedication to our shared mission.





Objectives:

• Manage and organize the CEO's daily schedule, including meetings, appointments, and travel arrangements.

• Act as a gatekeeper, screening and prioritizing communications to the CEO.

• Coordinate and facilitate communication between the CEO and internal/external stakeholders.

• Anticipate the CEO's needs and proactively handle tasks to ensure optimal time management.

• Coordinate special projects and initiatives as assigned by the CEO.





Competencies:

• Exceptional organizational and multitasking skills, with keen attention to detail.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion in handling sensitive information.

• Proficient in using Microsoft Office and Google Suites.

• Familiarity with scheduling software; experience with additional productivity tools is an advantage.

• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with individuals at all levels.

• Proactive problem solver and resourceful thinker.





Equipment Requirements:

• Must own a reliable computer or laptop capable of handling administrative tasks efficiently.

• Must own and actively use an iPhone and/or MacBook or Mac computer for efficient communication and task management.

• High-speed internet connection to support video calls, cloud-based collaboration, and remote work.





Physical Requirements:

• Extended periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.



Benefits:

• Growth opportunities in a well-established company.

• Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.

• Opportunity for advancement within the company.

• A supportive and collaborative work environment.

• Company-observed paid United States holidays (full time).

• Paid vacation.





How to Apply:



If you are ready to join Power Plus Systems, LLC, a well-established residential electrical contractor that values its tea
mbers and offers excellent benefits, please submit your application through the link below.




/internationalcareers



Power Plus Systems, LLC is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds to apply.



Join us at Power Plus Systems, LLC, and be part of our continued success as we embark on the next 20 years of excellence in residential electrical contracting!

title: Financial Accountant (Dutch GAAP Specialist)
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled, licensed CPA to manage the end-to-end accounting and financial reporting for a Dutch Fiscal Unity consisting of four entities. You will be responsible for ensuring that the administration is "audit-ready" or "compilation-ready", managing complex intercompany reconciliations, and ensuring full compliance with Dutch accounting standards.



Key Responsibilities

Full Cycle Accounting: Manage the daily/monthly bookkeeping and financial processing for all four entities within the fiscal unity.



Year-End File Preparation: Prepare high-quality working papers and lead the preparation of the annual accounts to create the financial statements according to Dutch GAAP.



Fiscal Unity Management: Handle complex intercompany transactions, eliminations, and corrections within the fiscal unity structure.



Compliance & Corrections: Perform period-end closing procedures, including VAT reconciliations and necessary journal corrections.



Software Management: Maintain the administration within Exact Online, ensuring optimal use of the system's features.



Audit/Tax Readiness: Serve as the primary point of contact for the external tax advisor or auditor, providing all necessary documentation for Corporate Income Tax (VPB) filings.



Required Qualifications & Skills

Licensure: Active CPA or equivalent international certification.



Dutch Expertise: Proven experience with Dutch GAAP and the Dutch fiscal landscape.



Software: Proficiency in Exact Online (
)  is necessary to complete this project.



Experience: At least 5+ years of experience in complex accounting environments, preferably having worked with holding structures or fiscal unities.



Language: Professional fluency in English; the ability to read Dutch financial terminology and legal documents is a significant advantage. (AI translations & usage allowed)



Analytical Rigor: Strong attention to detail regarding intercompany balances and corrections.



If the project is completed, it is possible to get a full-time job with us.

title: Senior Dispute & Payment Operations Manager (Remote)
description:

We are specifically looking for someone with proven experience working with payment providers and dispute management systems, including:

• Airwallex

• Ocean Payments (OC Payments)

• Daily monitoring and handling of disputes and chargebacks

• Creating processes and improving payment operations

Initially, the workload will be manageable, but we are heavily investing in launching many new stores and expect this role to grow significantly over time.



This position offers a high degree of flexibility and remote working. The successful candidate will become an important part of our organization and may eventually lead additional team members as the department expands.

• Demonstrable experience in dispute and chargeback management

• Experience with PayPal, Airwallex, Ocean Payments, Payoneer and payment processors

• Strong analytical and organizational skills

• Excellent written English communication skills

• Experience in e-commerce is highly preferred

• Ability to work independently and take ownership



Salary is negotiable and depends on experience.

title: SHORT-FORM CLIPPER + SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER
description:
TITLE: Short-Form Video Clipper + Social Media Manager — Cultural Commentary YouTube Channel



TYPE: Remote | Long-term | Part-time | $400–550 CAD/month base + performance bonus | ~20–25 hrs/month



ABOUT THE CHANNEL *

We're building a YouTube-first media studio around a host-led video podcast and cultural commentary channel covering politics, history, culture, and current events. Short-form is not an afterthought — every episode produces a full clip bank. As the studio expands into additional channels, this role grows with it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO *

• Use AI tools (Opus Clip, Spikes Studio, CapCut) to identify top clip candidates from long-form episodes, then apply your own judgment to select, refine, and publish the best ones

• Cut, caption, and format clips for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts — platform-native formatting for each

• Rewrite or sharpen the opening hook on every clip — you understand that the first 2 seconds determine performance

• Review and correct AI-generated captions for accuracy, timing, and readability

• Manage TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts accounts: posting, scheduling, account hygiene, and basic community responses

• Publish clips on a consistent weekly schedule

• Send a weekly clip performance report: views, watch time, follower movement



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR *

• Portfolio of short-form clips you have made — TikTok, Reels, or Shorts links (required — no examples, no consideration)

• Strong instinct for what stops the scroll in the first 2 seconds — you can explain why a clip works

• Platform-native fluency across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

• Experience managing social media accounts: posting schedules, account hygiene, basic growth

• Caption quality — accuracy, timing, readability

• Consistent publishing discipline — you hit schedules without being chased

• Experience with AI clip tools: Opus Clip, Spikes Studio, CapCut, or similar



Bonus — not required:

• Experience clipping from podcast, commentary, documentary, or cultural channels

• Experience growing a creator account from low or zero following



THE PERFORMANCE BONUS

Base retainer covers monthly clip volume and account management. Performance bonus: for clips that exceed 15,000 views, you earn $1.50–2.00 CAD per 1,000 views above that threshold. No cap.



TO APPLY *

• Links to 3–5 short-form clips you have made

• One sentence: how do you d
 which 
nt in a long video is worth clipping?

• Which AI tools you use in your clipping workflow

• Monthly rate and weekly availability

title: Video Editor + YouTube Channel Manager — Cultural Commentary & Podcast Channel
description:
TITLE: Video Editor + YouTube Channel Manager — Cultural Commentary & Podcast Channel



TYPE: Remote | Long-term | Part-time to Full-time | $650–900 CAD/month retainer



ABOUT THE CHANNEL *

We're building a YouTube-first media studio around a host-led video podcast and cultural commentary channel. The content sits at the intersection of people's history, politics, culture, and current events — research-grounded and built for a real audience. Think long-form conversation meets sharp cultural analysis.



This is the first hire for a studio being built for the long term. The right person grows into a senior role as we expand into additional channels.



WHAT YOU'LL DO *

• Edit long-form YouTube episodes — video podcast (30–60 min) and video essays (10–20 min) — from raw footage to finished, publish-ready videos

• Produce a weekly analytics summary: CTR, average view duration, top-performing content

• Flag short-form clip 
nts during editing with timestamps



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR *

• Portfolio showing 2–3 long-form YouTube videos you have edited — 15 minutes or longer (links required — no portfolio, no consideration)

• Experience managing a YouTube channel: metadata, analytics, publishing cadence — not just uploading

• Familiarity with Descript and Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve

• Understanding of what holds audience retention across a 20–30 minute video

• Reliable communication — you flag problems early, you don't disappear

• Open to or already using AI tools (Descript, Gling, TubeBuddy/VidIQ) in your workflow

• Experience with political commentary, documentary, podcast, or cultural content

• Experience working with a host-led creator channel



THE WORK

Phase One: 3–4 long-form edits per month plus ongoing channel management. Scope and rate grow as the studio expands.



TO APPLY *

title: Social Content Repurposing Specialist (TikTok ? Reels, Shorts, LinkedIn + Carousels)
description:
You already know that one good video can live in five places. Most people just never move it there.



I run a CRO agency and I post 15 short-form videos a week, mostly on TikTok. Right now every one of them dies on a single platform. That is the problem you are going to fix, and it is clean, focused work you can fit around your other clients.



Here is what the role looks like in practice. I drop my finished videos into a shared folder, already exported clean from CapCut. You take it from there. All 15 get reposted to YouTube Shorts each week. The ones that perform well move to Instagram Reels and LinkedIn. And the real winners get rebuilt into Instagram and LinkedIn carousels a week or two later, using a fixed template I give you.



You are a good fit because you have done this before, for an agency or for multiple clients, and you can show me one TikTok you turned into a Reel and explain what you changed for that platform. If you cannot name a single difference between how a video should look on TikTok versus LinkedIn, this is not your role, and that is fine.

What you will own each week:



Reposting all 15 videos from the folder to YouTube Shorts with correct captions and hashtags per platform

Moving the best performers to Instagram Reels and LinkedIn

Building Instagram and LinkedIn carousels from winning videos using my template and brief (I give you the hook and key points, you design and assemble in Canva or Figma)

Scheduling everything at the right times per platform

Keeping a simple log of what was posted where, and flagging what performed



What you do NOT need to worry about:



Writing the original scripts. That stays with me.

D
 which videos are winners. I give you the rule.



As the kind of content person who actually enjoys this, you care about the small things: no TikTok watermark bleeding onto a Reel, the right aspect ratio, a caption that fits the platform instead of being copy-pasted across all four.



About working with me. I pay on time, every month, no exceptions. I write clear briefs and record Looms so you are never guessing. This is steady, predictable part-time work that sits nicely alongside your other clients. The first week is paid: one batch of content, so we both see if it works before we commit. Most people I work with stay for years because they know exactly what is expected and they get paid like clockwork.



To apply, do these three things (applications that skip this get deleted, because following instructions is the whole job):



Start your message with the word "REPURPOSE" so I know you read this

Send me one example: a TikTok or short video you turned into a Reel, Short, or carousel, with one line on what you adjusted for that platform

Tell me which scheduling tool you have used before (Metricool, Later, Buffer, or other)



I am hiring one person for this and I review applications as they come in. The role closes once I find the right fit, so if this sounds like you, apply today rather than bookmarking it for later.

If you live and breathe AI video tools and understand what makes an ad stop the scroll, this role is for you.

AI UGC Videos

Realistic videos of AI-generated people speaking directly to the camera — indistinguishable from real UGC content. Think: someone standing on their porch talking about a supplement, a person in a kitchen reviewing a product, a relatable face explaining a health tip.

Requirements

2+ years of experience creating AI-generated video content for ads or social media

* Stay up-to-date with current SEO trends, search engine algorithm updates, and industry best practices.



Qualifications



* Minimum 2–5+ years of experience in SEO, link building, or digital marketing.

title: HubSpot Specialist
description:
Position Overview:

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented HubSpot Specialist to join our team and help us get the very best out of HubSpot. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building smart systems, improving processes, automating manual work, and supporting teams with practical HubSpot solutions.



You will play a key role in managing and optimising our HubSpot environment, with a strong focus on automation, workflows, pipeline set-up, lead management, and user adoption. The right person will be confident working across teams and will be passionate about creating efficient, scalable, and easy-to-use systems.



Key Responsibilities:



HubSpot Administration and Platform Management

- Manage and maintain the HubSpot platform across relevant hubs, including Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, Service Hub, Content Hub, Operations Hub, and/or Commerce Hub.

- Support the set-up, configuration, and ongoing optimisation of HubSpot tools, properties, pipelines, forms, lists, workflows, and user access.

- Ensure HubSpot is structured in a clean, consistent, and scalable way to support business growth.

- Maintain data quality and system integrity by helping enforce naming conventions, governance standards, and best-practice processes.



Automation and Workflow Optimisation

- Build, manage, and optimise HubSpot workflows to automate repetitive tasks and improve operational efficiency.

- Use HubSpot automation tools such as workflows, sequences, and bots to support lead management, customer journeys, task creation, notifications, and internal handovers.

- Review existing workflows and identify opportunities to simplify, improve, or automate processes.

- Collaborate with teams to understand their pain points and create practical automation solutions that save time and reduce manual work.



Sales Pipeline and Lead Management

- Support the design, implementation, and optimisation of sales pipelines within HubSpot.

- Work closely with lead generation and marketing teams to improve lead capture, lead scoring, lead nurturing, and qualification processes.

- Help streamline pipeline stages, deal movement, task reminders, and sales handover processes.

- Monitor pipeline performance and identify areas where processes can be improved to support stronger conversion and sales efficiency.



Training, Support, and Documentation

- Provide day-to-day HubSpot support to internal users.

- Train tea
mbers on HubSpot workflows, best practices, and platform features.

- Create and maintain documentation for HubSpot processes, automations, pipeline rules, and system usage.

Encourage strong user adoption by making HubSpot easier and more effective for teams to use.



Qualifications and Experience:

- Minimum of 2 years’ experience working with HubSpot administration, implementation, or optimisation.

- HubSpot Certification is required.

- Hands-on experience with HubSpot automation, workflows, pipelines, sequences, properties, lists, and user management.

- Strong understanding of CRM processes, sales pipelines, lead management, and workflow automation.

- Excellent attention to detail and a structured approach to system management.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills.

- Proactive mindset with a passion for improving processes and helping teams work more efficiently.



Application Requirements: This role demands a full-time commitment and is not compatible with another full-time job.

HubSpot Reporting and Dashboard Management

- Build, manage, and optimise HubSpot reports and dashboards across sales, marketing, service, and customer engagement activities.

title: Sales Manager
description:
Pex Life Records is an independent label where urban music meets personal development. Founded by Wilmarck, we create high-quality tracks that resonate with the motivation of Tony Robbins, blended with the commercial sound of artists like Kanye West and Drake. Our music is purpose-driven, focusing on critical life areas: health, financial literacy, peak performance, and spirituality.



You will be joining a brand with a strong, engaged audience of over 1,000
 subscribers and 20,
 followers. Your work will directly contribute to inspiring and uplifting thousands through music.-----The Role: Drive Revenue, Build a Team, Shape a Brand



We are seeking a highly motivated Music Manager to lead our sales, operations, and team development. This is a pivotal role for a professional ready to commit to a 45-50 hour/week position that offers substantial commission potential and a clear path to high earnings.



Key Areas of Impact:

Sales & Business Development: Lead client acquisition by pitching proposals to songwriting job boards and driving profits to achieve ambitious sales targets.

Team Leadership: Recruit, hire, train, and inspire contractors and staff to ensure stellar performance and successful new releases.

Operations & Finance: Manage contracts, maintain essential financial records (bookkeeping), and ensure compliance and seamless communication across all stakeholders.

Customer Experience: Be the face of the company, creating memorable customer experiences, explaining product/service prices, and handling key inquiries.



Compensation & Uncapped Earning Potential



This is a performance-driven role with a clear path to significant monthly income through our incentive program.

Base & Growth: The hourly rate starts at $2.81 USD plus commission. The initial 10 hours/week commitment quickly scales up to 45 hours/week within 45 days, allowing for a rapid increase in base earnings.

Monthly Compensation Range: $505–$900 Guaranteed Base + Generous Commission.



Compensation Structure by Target Revenue Goal:

Achieve $1,200 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $675 Minimum. Commission Rate: 10% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: 13th Month Pay, Internet Costs Reimbursement, Profit Sharing, PhilHealth Reimbursement.

Achieve $2,400 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $900 Minimum. Commission Rate: 15% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: Social Security System & Pag-IBIG Fund Reimbursement, 50% HMO Expenses, Profit Sharing.



Flexibility and Structure:



100% Remote Position: Work from anywhere.

Core Availability: Sunday–Thursday, 6:30 PM EST – 3:00 AM EST.

Work/Life Balance: We offer Flexible Scheduling (choose your working days/hours) and Job Sharing options.

Prospect Response Disclaimer: Maintain key client relationships by being available for 3-5 quick, 5–15 minute responses per week within a designated 8-hour window (e.g., 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM EST).



What We're Looking For (Skills & Qualities)



We need a relentless executor with an independent spirit and high integrity.

Essential: Superior proposal writing, persistence, time management, and strong English speaking/writing skills.

Ideal Candidate: Flexible, eager to learn, competitive, and receptive to constructive criticism.



Your Path to Full-Time: The Paid Audition



We skip the traditional hiring steps and go straight to evaluating your work. The process is designed to be fair, fast, and merit-based:

1 Submit your proposal.

2 Pass a screening exercise.

3 Participate in an interview.

4 Top candidates are selected for a paid audition to ensure a mutual fit before a full-time offer is extended.

If you are ready to be a crucial leader in a high-growth, mission-driven music company, apply now!



Application Instructions:



Demonstrate your expertise in sales management (client acquisition, appointment setting, and closing calls) in your proposal. To ensure you've read these details, please begin your proposal with the phrase "purple elephant."

description:

Schedule: Monday – Friday

* Strong written and spoken English

* Comfortable answering phone calls and texting clients professionally

* Organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage a daily schedule

* Reliable and responsive during working hours

* Able to follow systems, procedures, and a training manual

A big part of this role is SOURCING the leads. You'll research and build targeted contact lists of purchasing and IT decision-makers — using tools I provide (like Apollo and LinkedIn Sales Navigator) plus your own careful research — then run a weekly cold

- Load lists into a cold

- Log each warm lead in a shared Google Sheet/CRM (name, company, what they're sourcing, their reply) and notify me to quote

I provide all the tools, the sending domain, and the data subscriptions. You don't need to bring your own contact lists — I want someone skilled at sourcing and verifying leads with proper tools, not someone selling a pre-built database.



MUST-HAVE SKILLS

 campaigns (Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist, Mailshake, etc.)

- Honest and detail-oriented about data quality



NICE TO HAVE

-
 deliverability know-how (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, inbox warmup)

- Prior experience selling into US businesses

- Familiarity with IT/tech products



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your message with the word "TRANSPARENT" so I know you read the full post.

2. Tell me which lead-gen and cold
 tools you've used, and for how long.

3. Quick test: Pick any real mid-sized US company. Walk me through the exact steps and tools you'd use to find and verify the business
 of their IT Manager or Purchasing contact.

Applications that don't start with "TRANSPARENT" or that skip the test won't be considered. I read every qualifying application personally.

title: Remote Bookkeeper + Customer Support Specialist
description:
We're a growing flower business looking for a detail-obsessed bookkeeper who genuinely enjoys making numbers tie out to the penny. You'll own the daily financial pulse of the business — tracking every sale across Shopify, cash, and Zelle, reconciling team logs against actual payments, and catching discrepancies before they become problems.



This is not a passive data-entry role. We need someone who notices when something doesn't add up and digs until they find out why.



What You'll Do

Daily (the core of the job):

*Record all sales across Shopify, cash, and Zelle in QuickBooks

*Reconcile the team's daily sales logs against actual payments received

*Track inventory movement (incoming, sold, remaining, wastage)

*Flag discrepancies, missing items, or anything that looks off

*Submit a daily report summarizing sales, cash position, and any variances



Weekly:

*Maintain Excel reports for sales, inventory, and cash trends

*Prepare a weekly summary report for the owner

Reconcile bank activity and payment processor payouts



As needed:

*Respond to customer messages when the team is tied up

*Support the owner with light admin tasks tied to financial operations



What We're Looking For

Required:

*Real QuickBooks experience (you can explain the difference between a sales receipt and an invoice without thinking)

*Strong Excel skills — pivot tables, SUMIFS, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and you build formulas, not just formatted tables

*Multi-channel sales reconciliation experience (ideally Shopify + cash + a digital payment app like Zelle, PayPal, GCash, etc.)

*Honest, calm, and methodical — you document your work and aren't defensive when asked to explain it

*Clear English communication, written and spoken

*Reliable internet and a quiet workspace for the daily report



Bonus points for:

*Retail or perishable inventory experience

*Bookkeeping for a US-based small business

*Experience reconciling Shopify payouts (you know payout timing and fee handling)



What This Job Is Not

*It's not a place to learn QuickBooks from scratch — we need someone who already works in it daily.

*It's not a 9-to-5 with someone watching over you. You'll work independently, which means missed reports are immediately visible.

*It's not a stepping stone — we want someone who'll grow with us for at least 18–24 months. Bonuses and pay increases are tied to performance and tenure.



How to Apply

Send the following to 

1. A 1–2 minute voice recording answering this question: "Walk me through how you would handle this situation — at the end of the day, the team's sales log shows $1,847 in cash sales, but the cash drawer only has $1,790. What do you do?"

2. A sample of your bookkeeping or Excel work — a sanitized reconciliation, sales report, or inventory tracker you've actually built. Screenshots or files are fine. Templates downloaded from the internet don't count.

3. A short note with:

*Your years of QuickBooks experience

*Your current timezone and weekly hours of availability

*One sentence on why this role fits you right now



Applications missing any of these three items will not be reviewed. We're serious about detail — the application itself is the first test.

title: Remote Dispatcher / DSR — Plumbing & HVAC Service Coordination (ServiceTitan)
description:
Employment type: Full-time, long-term

Hours: [40 hrs/week] — must cover Canadian business hours, Mountain Time (MST/MDT). Roughly 7:30AM MST - 4:30PM MST. Same schedule every week; this role requires being reachable in real time during the workday.

Salary: $1000 CAD/month, paid [bi-weekly/monthly]. Performance bonuses tied to schedule efficiency and conversion.

Location: Remote (work from home)





About High Point



High Point Plumbing & Heating is a Canadian home-services company built on Pure Motive Service — being a window that shows customers every honest solution, never a door that stands in the way. The CSR works hard to book the call; the Dispatcher makes sure the right Technician walks through that window. We have detailed manuals and a full training program, and we'll teach you our exact systems. We want someone to own this role and grow with us for the long haul.



The Role



The Dispatcher (DSR) is the air-traffic controller of our service day. You know where every Technician is at all times, you assign calls by priority and skill so each customer gets the best possible outcome, and you keep the whole schedule moving. You dispatch to the opportunity — matching the right Tech to the right call — and you live by Zero Tolerance for Turndown: no customer gets left behind a closed door.





What You'll Do



Track all Technicians throughout the day and keep the dispatch board current in ServiceTitan

Dispatch calls in the right order: priority ? technician skill ? area ? time

Maintain constant real-time communication with Technicians via phone and Slack

Send complete call details to Techs (customer info, history, problem, special instructions, PO numbers)

Monitor progress and make delay/reschedule calls early — by the midpoint of the time window, never letting a customer wonder if we forgot them

Enforce Zero Tolerance for Turndown: flag every dispatch-fee-only/no-sale call and coordinate a supervisor or QC tech to revisit the options

Coordinate parts and Purchase Orders with the Warehouse Manager to keep Techs productive

Manage call completion, follow-ups, recalls, and after-hours/emergency scheduling per priority rules

Verify technician timecards (ServiceTitan / Fleet Pro), run end-of-day closeout, and prep next-day first calls

Run the daily check-in meetings (9:30 AM / 11:00 AM / 2:00 PM) with the CSR and Service Manager

Keep Technicians on track calmly and professionally, using caring "coaching one-liners" — never arguing





Must-Haves (Please don't apply without these)



Hands-on ServiceTitan experience (real daily use, ideally including dispatch/scheduling and Fleet Pro)

HVAC and/or plumbing trade background — you understand call priority, urgency, parts, and terminology

Excellent spoken English — clear, confident, calm communication with Technicians and customers

Sales / conversion mindset — you grasp why dispatching to the opportunity and Zero Tolerance for Turndown drive revenue, not just logistics

Strong multitasking, calm under pressure, and obsessive about following up

Reliable high-speed internet, quality headset, quiet workspace, and backup power/internet





Nice-to-Haves



Prior dispatching experience for a North American home-services / trades company

Experience coordinating field technicians and managing a live schedule





How to Apply (read carefully — this is how we screen)



Start your application with the word "DISPATCH-MVP" so we know you read the whole post.

Tell us in 3–4 sentences about your ServiceTitan/dispatch experience and your plumbing/HVAC background.

Briefly describe how you'd handle this: It's 3:30 PM, a Technician is running an hour behind on a job, and you have two more customers waiting in his afternoon window. Walk us through your next steps.

Attach a 60-second voice recording in English so we can hear your phone presence.





Applications without the voice sample and the scenario answer will not be reviewed. We're excited to meet our next Service MVP.

title: Copywriter – B2B Growth & Marketing
description:
Key Responsibilities:

- Develop Persuasive Copy: Write clear, compelling, and persuasive sales copy for a variety of outbound and inbound channels, including
 campaigns, cold outreach, website, landing pages, social media, lead generation campaigns, and sales enablement materials.

- Understand Target Audience: Conduct research to understand the pain points, needs, ambitions, and decision-making drivers of gigCMO’s target audience, including start-ups, scale-ups, SMEs, founders, business owners, and senior decision-makers seeking strategic marketing leadership and revenue growth.

- Implement Effective SEO Practices: Conduct keyword optimisation and create customer-centric website copy that improves search visibility, attracts qualified prospects, and supports gigCMO’s positioning as a growth consultancy.

- Conduct Competitor Analysis: Study the messaging, positioning, and copywriting techniques of competitors, fractional CMO providers, marketing consultancies, and relevant growth advisory businesses to identify best practices, market gaps, and opportunities to strengthen gigCMO’s communications.

- Create Engaging Content: Develop attention-grabbing subject lines, headlines, calls to action, website copy, landing page copy, campaign messaging, and thought leadership content that encourages engagement and conversion.

- Master the Company’s Product/Service: Build a deep understanding of gigCMO’s services, including strategic marketing leadership, fractional CMO support, growth consultancy, go-to-market strategy, playbook-driven marketing, knowledge transfer, and marketing capability development.

- Translate Strategic Services into Clear Messaging: Simplify complex marketing, growth, and consultancy concepts into clear, commercially relevant, and customer-focused copy that resonates with business leaders.

- Collaborate with Lead Gen and HubSpot Teams: Work closely with the Lead Generation and HubSpot teams to align copy with campaign strategies, CRM workflows, customer journeys, sales funnels, and revenue growth objectives.

- Optimise for Performance: Continuously test and optimise copy to improve open rates, click-through rates, conversion rates, engagement, lead quality, and overall campaign performance.

- Report on Copy Performance: Synthesise copy performance data and insights into actionable recommendations for campaign optimisation, messaging improvements, and future copy strategy.

- Maintain Brand Consistency: Ensure all copy reflects gigCMO’s brand positioning, tone of voice, value proposition, and focus on measurable business growth.

- Stay Up-to-Date: Keep up with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in copywriting, B2B marketing, SEO, outbound and inbound sales strategies, fractional marketing leadership, and AI-assisted marketing workflows.



Primary Brand Focus:

You will primarily write copy for gigCMO, a growth consultancy that provides strategic marketing leadership and expertise to start-ups, scale-ups, and SMEs to help drive profitable revenue growth.



Your work will support gigCMO’s own marketing, lead generation, website,
 campaigns, social media, thought leadership, sales enablement, and client-facing communications. The copy should clearly communicate gigCMO’s value proposition: helping businesses turn marketing into a structured, measurable growth engine through marketing leadership, playbook-driven execution, and knowledge transfer.



You will also support copywriting initiatives across selected client brands or related projects as needed.



Qualifications:

- Marketing and Sales Experience: Proven understanding of marketing and sales principles, with a track record of crafting copy that drives action, supports lead generation, and contributes to measurable commercial outcomes.

- Research Skills: Ability to conduct thorough research and synthesise information into clear, compelling, and customer-focused narratives for B2B audiences.

- Proven Copywriting Experience: At least 5 years of relevant experience in copywriting, content writing, marketing communications, or related fields.

- Strong Writing Skills: Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with a keen eye for detail and the ability to adapt tone and style across different channels, audiences, and stages of the marketing funnel.

- Creativity: Innovative thinker with the ability to generate unique ideas, messaging angles, campaign concepts, and copy that differentiates gigCMO in the market.

- Collaboration: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with Lead Generation, HubSpot, marketing, sales, and leadership teams.

- Time Management: Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, competing priorities, and deadlines.

- Analytical Skills: Proficient in using analytics tools to extract and measure copy performance metrics, including open rates, click-through rates, conversion rates, engagement data, lead quality, and search visibility.

- Data-driven Thinking Skills: Ability to interpret, evaluate, and synthesise data findings and insights to inform strategic decisions, identify patterns, and improve copy, messaging, and campaign performance.

- Product/Service Knowledge: Ability to rapidly build a deep understanding of gigCMO’s services and translate strategic marketing, fractional CMO, growth consultancy, and capability-building concepts into compelling, customer-centric narratives.

- Strategic Vision: Ability to position each piece of copy within the broader context of the campaign strategy, marketing funnel, customer journey, sales process, and brand identity, recognising that copy does not exist in isolation.

- Commercial Awareness: Strong understanding of how marketing supports revenue growth, lead generation, customer acquisition, and long-term business capability.

- B2B Communication Skills: Ability to write confidently for founders, business owners, senior executives, and decision-makers across start-ups, scale-ups, and SMEs.

title: Short-Form Food Video Editor — Recipe Reels, TikToks & Social Media Videos
description:
Short-Form Food Video Editor — Recipe Reels, TikToks & Social Media Videos



This is a great fit for an experienced video editor who already has a job, steady income, or other clients, and wants a flexible side hustle with real long-term upside. This is not meant for someone who needs a high full-time salary immediately. It is paid from the beginning, but the bigger opportunity is growing with the brand through performance bonuses and upside opportunities as sales increase.



The right person can keep their current job, work on their own schedule, and make a bet on a food content brand that has the potential to eventually become much more valuable over time. This is results-driven work for someone with long-term vision, strong taste, and the ability to make food content feel polished, appetizing, and scroll-stopping.



We are looking for a short-form food video editor to edit recipe videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts,
, Pinterest, and other social platforms.



You will be turning raw food clips, AI-generated clips, cooking shots, plating shots, and recipe footage into short-form videos that feel realistic, delicious, fast-paced, and social-media ready.



What You’ll Do



You will edit short-form recipe videos, including:



- Instagram Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, and other vertical videos

- Fast-paced recipe edits with strong pacing and clean transitions

- Hook-first videos that grab attention in the first 1–3 seconds

- Food-focused edits that make the recipe look indulgent, realistic, and delicious

- Text overlays, captions, recipe callouts, and simple on-screen instructions

- Cutting out dead space and choosing the most appetizing shots

- Syncing clips with music, voiceover, or sound effects when needed

- Creating multiple versions of the same video for testing hooks, pacing, or structure

- Making revision edits based on feedback



The goal is to create content that looks premium, appetizing, and made for social media — not boring recipe videos, not generic AI-looking content, and not slow edits that people scroll past. If you see this, write the word goldfish in your subject line for the application.



Types of Videos You’ll Edit



Examples include:



- High-protein comfort food meal prep videos

- Recipe reels with hook + cooking process + final plated shot

- AI-generated food clip videos

- Before/after food transformations

- Sauce pours, cheese pulls, sizzling pans, chopping, mixing, plating, and meal prep shots

- Problem/solution style videos for busy people who want healthy meals that still taste indulgent

- Variations of the same recipe video for testing different hooks



You Might Be a Great Fit If



- You already edit short-form videos and understand TikTok/Reels pacing.

- You spend time watching food videos and recipe content.

- You can tell when food looks realistic, delicious, and appetizing.

- You know how to make the first 1–3 seconds of a video stronger.

- You understand pacing, cuts, captions, hooks, music, and retention.

- You notice small details that make a video feel polished.

- You can take feedback without ego and make edits quickly.

- You like flexible, output-based work that fits around your existing schedule.

- You’re looking for a side hustle rather than another full-time commitment.

- You want to grow with a brand where strong performance can lead to higher pay, bonuses, and more consistent work.

- You have long-term vision and understand that early-stage opportunities can grow into bigger income once the brand gains traction.



Requirements



- Experience editing short-form vertical videos

- Strong sense of pacing and retention

- Good visual taste for food content

- Ability to make food look appetizing, indulgent, and premium

- Comfortable adding captions, text overlays, music, and basic sound effects

- Ability to follow detailed instructions and brand style

- Reliable communication

- Ability to meet deadlines

- Organized file delivery

- Willingness to edit multiple versions when testing hooks or formats

- Must be able to accept feedback and make revisions



Experience editing food videos is a huge plus, but not required if you have strong short-form editing skills and a good eye for what performs on social media.



Tools / Software



You can use the editing software you are most comfortable with, such as:



- CapCut

- Premiere Pro

- DaVinci Resolve

- Final Cut Pro

- After Effects

- Canva, when needed for simple graphics or text

- Google Drive or Dropbox for file sharing



Bonus points if you are also comfortable working with AI-generated clips or understand how to make AI footage feel more natural through editing.



Pay



This is output-based freelance work and should be viewed as a flexible side hustle with growth potential.



- $5 per edited short-form video

- Pay includes the opportunity for performance bonuses

- Strong performers may also participate in upside through performance bonuses

- As sales and content performance increase, there will be opportunities for larger pay, higher bonuses, and more consistent work

- The goal is for pay to increase significantly as the brand gains traction, especially for people who help build the system early and consistently deliver great work



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short message about why you are interested  

2. Your experience editing short-form videos  

3. Any experience with food videos, recipe content, AI clips, or social media content  

4. 2–5 examples of videos you have edited  

5. Your availability each week  

6. What editing software you use  

7. Confirm that you understand this is output-based side-hustle work with long-term upside: $5 per edited video, with performance bonuses and upside opportunities as the brand grows  



Bonus points if you can explain what makes a food video perform well on Reels, TikTok, or Shorts.

title: Direct Response Ecommerce Video Editor
description:
Hiring: Senior Direct Response Video Editor



We are a multi 7 figure a month supplement brand. Our vision is to scale this into a multi 9 figure business and build one of the biggest supplement brands sitting in retailers across the nation. We are looking to hire full time editors that are hungry and ready to join us to be a top brand in our space.



YOUR MISSION

Your mission is to produce high-converting direct response video ads at speed and at a standard that moves product. You will execute against proven scripts and frameworks, bring sharp editing instincts to every cut, and own the quality of every video that leaves your queue. The best editors here don't just edit, they think like marketers.



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Produce 2+ minute of high-quality direct response video ads per day following provided scripts and style guides

- Edit AI avatar videos that look smooth, realistic, and on-brand — this is a core function of the role

- Source and place B-roll and supporting footage that enhances copy lines and drives viewer action

- Apply direct response principles when reviewing scripts — you understand what makes people buy

- Operate with high autonomy, managing your daily queue efficiently without hand-holding

- Stay ahead of new AI tools and editing techniques as the landscape evolves

- Ensure every video meets our quality standards and matches provided instructions first time

- As a foundational tea
mber, help establish editing standards and onboard future editors as we scale





OUR TECH STACK

- Video Editing: CapCut Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro

- AI Avatar & Generation: HeyGen, Google Flow, Hedra

- Voiceover: ElevenLabs

- Image Generation: Midjourney, Krea

- Communication: Slack



KPIs YOU WILL OWN

- Daily Output: 2+ minutes of video edits per day, 10+ minutes per week

- Revision Rate: No more than 2 rounds of revisions per video



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Proven direct response video editing experience at a brand doing $10M+ per year — non-negotiable

- Strong AI avatar creation — HeyGen or equivalent, smooth and realistic output required

- Proficiency in CapCut Pro or Premiere Pro

- Experience in health, wellness, or supplements is a strong plus

- Deep understanding of DR principles — hooks, pacing, retention, and what drives conversions

- High autonomy operator who manages output and meets deadlines without being managed

- Strong written English for communication and script review

- Genuinely obsessed with creative performance, not just creative craft



WHY JOIN JFM VENTURES

- Performance bonuses for winning creatives — when your ads convert, you get paid for it

- High impact work — your edits run on real spend and reach real buyers every single day

- Direct line to founders & creative strategists — no layers, no politics

- Early tea
mber advantage — top performers will be given opportunities to lead and grow

- Fully remote — we measure output, not hours

- Fast-moving environment — we scaled from zero to $60K days in three weeks, the pace is real



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

- You need constant direction to stay productive

- You're a perfectionist who loses hours on a single transition — speed and quality both matter here

- You're uncomfortable with tools and formats changing fast — our environment shifts and you have to move with it

- You don't have real direct response experience — brand videos and social content is not the same

- You see this as a freelance side project — this is full-time and we need full commitment

- Paid media and DR marketing doesn't genuinely excite you — if it's just a job, this isn't the right fit



HOW TO APPLY

- If you're an elite direct response video editor who understands that every frame exists to drive a conversion, we want to hear from you.



Fill out the full application below. We review every application personally and if there's a fit, we'll be in touch shortly. Looking forward to speaking soon!

title: Implement & Manage Ai Agent
description:
AI Agent Engineer (E-Commerce Automation)



Role Overview



We are seeking a skilled and forward-thinking AI Agent Engineer to design, build, and deploy an autonomous AI agent tailored for our e-commerce platform. In this role, you will be responsible for creating an intelligent system that seamlessly handles end-to-end order flows (tracking, modifications, returns) and resolves customer service queries with high accuracy and a natural, brand-consistent voice.



The ideal candidate bridges the gap between advanced Machine Learning (LLMs, RAG) and practical software engineering, ensuring the AI agent is deeply integrated with our existing e-commerce stack.



Key Responsibilities



1. Agent Architecture & Development

 Design and deploy robust AI agents using frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or AutoGPT.



 Implement advanced orchestration techniques, including tool use (function calling), multi-agent collaboration, and self-correction loops.

 Optimize the agent's reasoning capabilities to handle complex, multi-step customer journeys.



2. E-Commerce Integration & Order Flow Automation

 Connect the AI agent to our e-commerce backend (e.g., Shopify, WooCommerce, or custom APIs) and ERP/inventory systems.

 Automate transactional workflows such as:

 Checking order status and tracking packages.

 Processing cancellations, returns, and refunds based on company policy.

 Modifying shipping addresses or order items post-purchase.



3. Customer Query Resolution & RAG

 Build and maintain a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline using vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, Qdrant) to ground the agent in our FAQs, return policies, and product catalogs.

 Ensure the agent provides accurate, empathetic, and context-aware responses to diverse customer inquiries.

 Implement smart handoff protocols to gracefully escalate complex or sensitive issues to human support agents.



4. Evaluation, Guardrails, & Optimization

 Establish rigorous evaluation frameworks to monitor agent accuracy, latency, and hallucination rates.

 Implement strict guardrails (e.g., NeMo Guardrails, Llama Guard) to ensure data privacy, security, and alignment with brand guidelines.

 Continuously fine-tune prompts and system instructions based on real-world user interaction logs.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Technical Requirements

 Programming: Proficient in Python or TypeScript/Node.js.

 AI/LLMs: Deep understanding of Large Language Models (OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude, open-source models like Llama) and prompt engineering techniques.

 Frameworks: Hands-on experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar agentic workflows.

 Data & APIs: Strong experience working with RESTful/GraphQL APIs, webhooks, and JSON data handling.

 Databases: Experience with vector databases and SQL/NoSQL systems.

Preferred Qualifications

 Prior experience building production-grade AI chatbots or autonomous agents.

 Familiarity with e-commerce platforms (Shopify API is a major plus) and customer service software (Zendesk, Gorgias, Intercom).

 Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and CI/CD pipelines for AI applications.

What We Offer

 Impact: You will own a core piece of our technology roadmap that directly impacts customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

 Innovation: Work at the bleeding edge of Generative AI and autonomous agent workflows.

Director of Media Growth & Operations (Executive Producer / Viral Architect)



(Full-Time Retainer + Heavy Performance-Based Equity Tiers for documented traffic/viral results)





We are expanding a premium, multi-platform digital media network and broadcast studio. Our content ecosystem centers on high-level cultural commentary, sports intersections, and political critiques. Our model: shooting television-grade long-form broadcast video podcasts and syndicating them down into a massive, daily network of high-velocity, short-form viral channels targeting Western (US/Canada/UK) demographics.



We are looking for a Director of Media Growth & Operations to serve as the structural engine of our production house. Your primary job is to manage the downstream creative team, run the backend distribution pipeline, and ensure our lead creator is handed bulletproof, high-potential assets so they can focus 100% of their energy on high-impact on-camera performance.



We are explicitly looking for an executive who fits one of two elite profiles:



The Viral Alchemist



You have a documented history of manufacturing viral success. You don't guess what works; you have personally scaled accounts, cracked algorithm triggers, or built decentralized clipping networks that have generated millions of views. You possess deep instincts for internet psychology, thumbnail optimization, high-retention editing cadences, and backend distribution architecture.



The Investigative Mastermind



You are an expert, high-level researcher who loves rabbit holes. You can take a trending mainstrea
dia clip (e.g., right-wing manosphere rhetoric, business grifts, or corporate gentrification narratives) and dig up the deep historical context, hidden financial data, and archival counter-arguments that completely expose the absurdity of the clip. You know how to structure complex socio-political data into flawless, high-retention storytelling blueprints.



---



### **Core Responsibilities:**



* **Content Curative Infrastructure:** Package hyper-targeted production briefs for the lead creator. This means either scraping daily trending media triggers for viral reaction points, or conducting deep investigative research to provide unassailable historical facts and logical "receipts."





* **Downstream Staffing & Management:** Take full operational ownership of our creative pipeline. You will design our production SOPs, audit asset delivery timelines, onboard specialized staff (editors, sound mixers, graphic partners), and hold them accountable to rigid production schedules.





* **Backend Media Operations & Security:** Supervise and implement advanced technical distribution frameworks. You must understand or be highly capable of mastering account security configurations, including anti-detect browsers and residential proxy networks, to ensure our remote team’s uploads are natively routed into target North American geolocations without algorithmic suppression.





* **Funnel Optimization & Performance Analytics:** Real-time auditing of retention graphs across YouTube Studio, TikTok, and Meta platforms. You will run thumbnail A/B testing frameworks, maximize click-through rates (CTR), and continuously optimize our top-of-funnel short-form traffic to route viewers into our broader business platforms.







---



### **Required Qualifications & Competencies:**



* **The Track Record:** *EITHER* a documented portfolio showing major viral growth metrics you directly architected, *OR* an extensive background in investigative research, journalism, political science, or high-level academic content creation.





* **Institutional Foundation:** A Bachelor’s or Master's Degree in Business, Marketing, Philosophy, Media Communication, History, Computer Science or a related discipline is highly valued 





* **Operations Mastery:** Experience managing multi-brand workflows, cross-functional remote teams, or digital agencies. You must be entirely comfortable working on an outcome-based deliverable model with complete autonomy.





* **Unique Tech Stack Competency:** Familiarity with modern content management architectures (Notion, Airtable), cloud asset flows, and generative AI research frameworks (e.g., prompting models like Claude or ChatGPT for trend aggregation and data mining). Media buying, performance marketing, or digital ad arbitrage experience is a major asset.







---

To ensure you have high attention to detail and can follow strict briefs, generic copy-and-paste applications will be automatically discarded.



Please reply with the subject line: Growth & Traffic 



In your cover letter, please include:



1. Which elite profile you fit best (**The Viral Alchemist** or **The Investigative Mastermind**) and the absolute best piece of evidence supporting your claim (e.g., a link to a channel you scaled, a piece of deep research you compiled, or a viral campaign you ran).



2. Your desired monthly salary baseline and your general weekly availability.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
We are a U.S.-based B2B industrial supply business looking for a graphic designer to support our ongoing e-commerce, marketing, and product documentation work.



1. Position Summary

We need a graphic designer who can produce clean, industrial-style visual assets across multiple formats — enhanced product content, e-commerce listing imagery, website imagery, packaging, labels, infographics, and product documentation.

Think 3M. Think Grainger. Think Uline. That is the visual register we work in: B2B industrial, utilitarian, spec-driven, durable-looking, function-first. Clean typography, technical illustration, performance claims front and center. This is not consumer retail — it is industrial supply.

That said, the design sensibility must be contemporary, not dated. We want modern industrial — the way the best B2B brands look today, not how a 1990s parts catalog looked. Visuals should feel current and relevant to today's working professionals — millennials and Gen X buyers in their 30s through 50s who are the actual decision-makers in industrial purchasing.

This is not a role for designers whose strongest work is lifestyle, beauty, fashion, wedding, or consumer-brand aesthetics. If your portfolio is built around pastels, soft-lifestyle photography, or "girly" branding, this is not your fit.

The right candidate is equally comfortable producing an enhanced content banner for an e-commerce listing and laying out a print-ready box label with regulatory text, lot numbers, and barcode placement.



2. Scope of Work

The designer will produce visual assets including:

Enhanced product content and e-commerce listing imagery (product detail page modules, brand store imagery, hero banners)

Website images and banners

Product labels and box label design (print-ready, with regulatory and barcode placement)

Box and packaging design

Infographics for product features, specifications, and application guides

Flyers, brochures, and sell sheets (digital and print)

Safety Data Sheet (SDS) formatting and layout support

Other ad-hoc graphic design work as needed



3. Required Skills & Experience

Proven portfolio of industrial, B2B, MRO, hardware, or technical product design — please include examples

Fluent in English — speaking, listening, and writing. You must be able to communicate effectively with us in real time, understand verbal direction clearly, and respond promptly in writing. This is non-negotiable.

A real creative streak and a contemporary design sensibility. Your work should look current and modern — industrial, but not dated. We need someone who brings ideas to the table, not someone who only applies templates. Designs must resonate with today's working-age buyers (roughly 30s through 50s), not feel like a relic from a previous generation.

Fluent with enhanced product content and e-commerce listing imagery requirements across major marketplaces (module structures, image specs, dimensions, file formats)

Experience designing print-ready files (labels, packaging, brochures) with attention to bleed, color profiles, and dieline accuracy

Strong typography and layout skills for dense, information-heavy content (specs, instructions, regulatory text)

Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) or equivalent professional tools

Ability to follow brand guidelines and maintain visual consistency across assets



To apply, please send over your resume and portfolio.

title: Hardware Embedded Electrical Engineer (KiCad / Raspberry Pi)
description:
This job is open to people with Electrical Engineering training. Both males and females of all backgrounds are encouraged to apply. 



We are seeking an Electrical Hardware Engineer to design and develop hardware upgrades for the Xerxes Pi platform and Xerxes for Jetson Nano. You will be responsible for creating robust, production-ready PCB designs using KiCad, with a focus on embedded computing, networking, and peripheral integration for home lab and edge AI systems.



This role involves working closely with compute module-based systems (CM4/CM5 and Jetson Nano variants), improving board-level functionality, and designing reliable expansion and upgrade paths for power, networking, and high-speed peripheral interfaces.



Key Responsibilities:



- Design and iterate PCB hardware using KiCad for embedded systems and compute modules

- Develop hardware upgrades for Xerxes Pi and Xerxes Jetson Nano platforms

- Design and implement Power over Ethernet (PoE) solutions for reliable device powering

- Work with I2C and I2S buses for sensor, audio, and peripheral integration

- Engineer and validate RJ45 Ethernet interfaces including signal integrity considerations

- Collaborate on board bring-up, testing, debugging, and hardware validation

- Support integration of storage, networking, and AI accelerator peripherals

- Produce manufacturing-ready schematics, layouts, and documentation



Required Skills & Experience:



- Strong experience with KiCad for schematic capture and PCB layout

- Solid understanding of PoE standards and practical implementation

- Experience working with I2C and I2S communication protocols

- Knowledge of Ethernet hardware design, including RJ45 magnetics and routing

- Familiarity with embedded Linux hardware platforms (Raspberry Pi CM4/CM5 or similar)

- Experience designing mixed-signal PCBs and high-speed digital interfaces

- Ability to troubleshoot hardware issues from prototype to production



Nice to Have:



- Experience with NVIDIA Jetson platforms

- Background in compute module carrier board design

- Familiarity with PCIe, USB 3.0, or M.2 integration

- Experience designing for thermal constraints in compact systems



This role is ideal for an engineer passionate about embedded systems, edge computing, and building scalable hardware platforms for advanced home lab and AI workloads.

About PropFix.ie



PropFix.ie is Ireland's trusted property maintenance specialist, offering comprehensive solutions with years of expertise across the construction and renovation sectors. We transform spaces through our diverse range of services, from handyman solutions and office fit-outs to complete renovations, house extensions, and specialized installations including doors, floors, partitions, and MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) systems.



Our commitment to delivering the best value property maintenance has established us as a reliable partner for residential and commercial clients nationwide. With decades of experience, including 50 years of expertise in garage conversions, we pride ourselves on impeccable craftsmanship, turning our clients' visions into reality while ensuring their properties remain in top condition.



Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented Quantity Surveyor/Office Engineer to join our dynamic team. This multifaceted role combines quantity surveying expertise with office engineering and financial administration, focusing on accurate cost estimation, project budgeting, and comprehensive project support. The successful candidate will work closely with our project managers, site teams, and clients to ensure precise cost control and seamless project delivery from concept to completion.



Key Responsibilities

Cost Estimation & Quantity Surveying



Project Estimating: Calculate materials, labor costs, and overall project budgets with precision

BOQ & BOM Preparation: Develop comprehensive Bills of Quantities and Bills of Materials for all projects

Job Pricing: Analyze construction plans and prepare detailed quantity requirements and pricing structures

Contract Analysis: Scrutinize maintenance costs, material expenses, and contracts to secure optimal deals

Tender Management: Analyze tenders and manage procurement processes for construction and design projects

Prepare accurate brickwork and blockwork quantity take-offs, including bricks, blocks, mortar, lintels, insulation, and related masonry components

Analyze brickwork labor and material rates to ensure competitive and accurate pricing

Coordinate and support MEP system costing, estimation, and documentation (mechanical, electrical, and plumbing works)

Estimating Tools: Utilize software including Simpro, JobTread, Bluebeam, PlanSwift, CostX, Measure Square, Stone Pro, and Microsoft Office to support estimating, budgeting, and project documentation.



Project Coordination & Client Management



Stakeholder Liaison: Coordinate with site managers, clients, contractors, and subcontractors to ensure smooth project execution

Reporting: Prepare comprehensive reports, analyses, contracts, budgets, and risk assessments

Strategic Advisory: Advise managers and clients on cost improvements, new strategies, and savings opportunities

Change Management: Document design changes and update budgets accordingly

Material Management: Track materials inventory and coordinate ordering when required



Financial Administration & Office Support



Invoice Management: Handle invoicing processes and perform data entry for financial documentation

Administrative Support: Assist staff accountants and handle various office and financial tasks

Client Administration: Manage administrative tasks delegated by clients with efficiency and accuracy

Technical Requirements



Quantity Surveying: Proven experience in cost estimation, BOQ preparation, and quantity surveying methodologies

Construction Knowledge: Strong understanding of construction processes, materials, and industry standards

2D/3D CAD Design: Experience or familiarity with 2D and 3D CAD software preferred for project visualization and technical drawings

Financial Acumen: Experience with budget management, financial reporting, and cost control

Contract Management: Knowledge of construction contracts, procurement, and tender analysis

Simpro Experience: Hands-on experience using Simpro for job costing, project budgeting, invoicing, and workflow management



Professional Skills



Analytical Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities with exceptional attention to detail

Software Proficiency: Competency in quantity surveying software, spreadsheet applications, and financial systems

Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for client and contractor liaison

Organization: Outstanding organizational skills with ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

Adaptability: Flexibility to handle diverse administrative and technical tasks

Competitive salary package

Professional development and training opportunities

Collaborative and supportive remote work environment

Career growth potential within an expanding company
